lecture_summary: The lecture develops torque and lever-arm balance as the physical basis for center of mass, then applies weighted-position reasoning to point masses, grouped blocks, composite solids, and a rod with variable linear density. Key strategies include choosing a consistent origin, grouping components, checking the expected location, and converting density into a mass element before integrating.
